verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents automations as Internal Agent tasks that run on a schedule (e.g., weekdays at 9am) or on a trigger (e.g., a GitHub PR merging), managed from an Automations page with templates. Per-automation auto-approve lets them act without waiting for human approval, and automations can watch tools and the support queue to surface gaps on their own. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended in the background.
